title: The Last Bite
_note: English text layer for Embla's EP1. The physiology (schemas/examples/sce-anaphylaxis-ep1.json), the beat->cutscene map and the rendered clips are reused unchanged — only the human-readable strings are translated. Nothing here is generated content.
fallback: …I can't really talk any more. Please help me.

dialogue.patient: Doctor… I can't breathe properly. I'm itching all over. I feel like I'm going to pass out.
Just now — about ten minutes ago. And it got worse really fast.
I'm allergic to shrimp. I ordered the salad and asked for no shrimp — but they must have put dried shrimp in it. I didn't notice until it was too late.
It's hard to breathe. Something is squeezing my throat. There's a wheeze when I breathe in.
My throat feels like it's closing. My voice is going hoarse and it hurts to swallow.
I've got red welts all over. It itches so much. My lips and my eyes are starting to swell.
I'm dizzy, my heart is racing, I feel like I'm about to black out.
I've reacted before but never like this. A doctor gave me a pen to carry — I left it at home.
No medical conditions. I don't take anything regularly.
Thank you, doctor… I'm really scared. Please help me.
